name: Kanade
source:
"Would you please fall in love with me?"

A girl born from the union of an alien mother and a human father.
She's trying to save the world through song in place of her mother,
who isn't there to do it anymore.

She's honest, kind, and tries her best at everything she does,
including her favorite thing in the world: singing.
While she is generally polite,
she sometimes surprises people with her out-of-this-world behavior,
which can be attributed to her half alien side.

She begins exchanging letters with Yuuto
after she finds his injured carrier pigeon and nurses it back to health.
Her greatest desire is to sing the greatest love song and save the world.
She travels to Yuuto's town in order to fulfill this wish.

[From [url=https://kanade.frontwing.co.jp/en/]official website[/url]]
